I found 23 source files under `src/` that call `assertOrgScope()`:

- **Route handlers and pages:** the usage route, the issue route, the org dashboard layout and its `tenant-context.ts`.
- **Services:** 16 files in `src/server/services/`.
- **Actions:** `switch-org.ts`.
- **Library:** `src/lib/actor.ts`, plus `src/lib/tenant.ts` itself.

I included `src/lib/tenant.ts` because, besides defining the guard, it calls it at line 40. If you only want callers outside the defining file, drop it. `src/types/member.ts` mentions the name but has no call to it, so it's left out. The files in `tests/` and `scripts/` are also left out because they aren't source files.

ANSWER: src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/usage/route.ts, src/app/api/issues/[issueId]/route.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_lib/tenant-context.ts, src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/session-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/actions/organizations/switch-org.ts, src/lib/actor.ts, src/lib/tenant.ts
